requirement: Agent-demo inventory of a large Joomla site finishes inside its 90 s cap with the same records, and a build's step budget grows with its template

oracle.ref: PR #1690 (fix); fix evidence: Local stand 24/10/2026: reverb-asian-fusion-res (Tracy Business j6, 7,787 records) hit AGENT_DEMO_INVENTORY_LIMIT at 90 s after 284 calls; after the fix 42 s, 341 calls, complete.
oracle.invariant: S1: records, hash and invariantHash identical; the bulk read makes fewer than 30 calls and no relation content.get. S2: more than one and at most 8 calls in flight; same record keys, coverage and hash as the calm read. S3: at most 8 calls after the refusal. S4: a small build keeps five times the bars, a 300/60 build has room past 55 looking and 250 steps, the cap holds at 120 looking and 480 steps.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
